name: daebot-desktop
description: Daebot desktop app: menu bar item, global shortcut, native window around the Daebot gateway and web UI.
author: Astra AI <anthony@theastraway.com>

scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/stage-bin.mjs mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/stage-bin.mjs win && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --publish never && DAEBOT_FEED_CHANNEL=latest-arm64 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/stage-bin.mjs linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux --x64 --publish never
